reason: The repository currently contains the backend specification and browser prototype, but no live PostgreSQL schema/migrations or import API implementation.

transaction.onValidationFailure: retain import job and rows; create no corpus document
transaction.onSuccess: create document, units, tokens, morphemes, annotations, translations, media attachment, provenance links, and revision zero

entityMapping.notes: One normal Hebrew corpus document; not an MP4-specific document.
Unit kind distinguishes title, vocabulary line, instruction, and exercise sentence.
Surface, normalized form, lemma link, root link, UPOS, features, and offsets after tokenizer confirmation.
Prefixes, stem, suffixes, grammatical function, and compact gloss.
Sentence translation with language=en and its own source/confidence.
Word translations remain distinct from grammatical glosses and may be polysemous.
Null and low-confidence values are valid pending review.
The MP3 attaches to the document; alignments are separate records.
Records transliteration/gloss conventions without hardcoding them into the UI.
Source files, hashes, mapping decisions, warnings, and original pointed strings are retained.

requiredBeforePersistence: Implement or select the initial SQLAlchemy/Alembic corpus migration.
Assign UUIDs inside the import transaction rather than baking them into this portable package.
Validate language, sentence order, token order, source hashes, translation language, and annotation types.
Choose dictionary/frequency sources only after checking licence and attribution requirements.

reimportIdentity.policy: matching identities create a new import/revision proposal, never a silent overwrite
